title: ophrys × buttleri
intro: Ophrys × buttleri, commonly known as the Bee Orchid, is a hybrid orchid species resulting from the cross between Ophrys apifera and Ophrys sphegodes. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys × buttleri are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and potential applications.
